title: PyKeithley_SMU2450: Python control of the Keithley 2450 SourceMeter
description: A Python library for controlling the Keithley 2450 SourceMeter (SMU) over Ethernet using TSP commands on a raw TCP socket — no VISA or vendor drivers required. Covers voltage/current sourcing with compliance limits, 2- and 4-wire sensing, linear I-V sweeps with buffer readout, source readback, trigger control, and Van der Pauw current-source configuration, with a command-line interface and a hardware verification script.
